name: Paclitaxel (single agent, weekly)
cyclesNote: Single-agent weekly paclitaxel for second-line metastatic esophageal / esophagogastric cancer; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: StewardMD ONCOTREE draft protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Hypersensitivity prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine before paclitaxel to reduce infusion hypersensitivity reactions.

supportiveCare: Single-agent taxane; monitor for peripheral neuropathy and myelosuppression.
Nutrition and dysphagia support as needed.

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce or hold paclitaxel for significant sensory neuropathy; physician decides.

drugs.name: Paclitaxel
drugs.notes: Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV weekly on days 1, 8, and 15 of a 28-day cycle (a common second-line schedule for metastatic esophageal / esophagogastric cancer). Give hypersensitivity premedication. StewardMD standard-of-care wording; physician decides and the dose engine computes the patient dose.
